errors.meaning: A document in `baseRevisions` moved since you read it. The answer carries the current `revisions` and the `missed` operations.
errors.fix: Read what moved (the missed operations, or the node again), rebuild the batch on the current revisions with a fresh `requestId`. Never resend blindly over someone else's change.

errors.meaning: The operation would leave its document as it is.
errors.fix: Nothing to do; drop the operation.

errors.meaning: The batch or an input is malformed: schema mismatch, `Missing base revision for <key>`, `<op> requires <x> confirmation`, a non-undoable or external operation sharing a batch, publication in a dry run, a reused `requestId` with a different batch.
errors.fix: Read the message: it names the field or rule. Fix the input against `discover_operations`, add the missing base revision or `confirmed`, split the batch.

errors.meaning: A `$ref` points at a later operation, itself, or a path its output lacks.
errors.fix: Reference only earlier operations, by their `ref`, with a path their output has.

errors.meaning: The token's role does not allow the operation (the message names the permission it needs), or the site's design-system access settings keep an area at view for editors: then `data` is `{ kind: "access", area, granted, needed }`.
errors.fix: Tell the user what needs which role. For a design-system area, a platform admin opens it in the admin (Design system > Permessi dei ruoli, column Editor); a new token does not help. Do not look for another way around it; open a ticket if the refusal looks wrong.

errors.meaning: The site or the committed request does not exist for this token.
errors.fix: Check the id; `history.undo` and `history.read` take a `requestId` that was applied on this site.

errors.meaning: A gate refused the change: tree invariants (codes such as `I5.section_placement`, `I8.default_stored`), the style catalogue, the design-system rules or the AA contrast gate. `detail` lists each failure with its path.
errors.fix: Change the input so the gate passes (another token, another parent, drop a stored default). Never work around a gate.

errors.meaning: The token is missing, expired, revoked, or its maker lost access.
errors.fix: The user makes a new token in the admin (Agenti e accessi MCP) and sets LIBRETTO_MCP_TOKEN.

tree.commit: A text prop keeps its shape: a plain string is the same in every language; a map `{ "it": "…", "en-US": "…" }` holds one text per language. Change only the language asked.
Style values may be tokens (`"{space.4}"`, `"{color.text.accent}"`) or raw CSS; use a token whenever one exists. Scopes are `base` and breakpoints such as `bp:md`; `null` removes a declaration.
Inserted nodes need fresh 8-character ids (`[0-9a-z]{8}`) unique in the page. `set_props` never stores a value equal to the default (`I8.default_stored`).
Findings in the answer cover the whole page: look at the ones whose `nodeId` you touched.
tree.read: The whole tree, often too large for the conversation. Read the outline resource first, then one node with `tree.node` (or `tree/<pageId>?node=<nodeId>&depth=1`).
preset.insert: A section preset goes under a tree root: the page root, or a region root from `region.read`. A section inside a region is refused as `I5.section_placement`. The answer's `nodeId` is the new node.
preset.list: Answers every preset with its whole tree: use `preset.index` (or the `presets` resource) to choose, then `preset.read` for one.
designSystem.setToken: A path that does not exist is created as a new token. Check the path in the `design-system` resource first; add tokens only on purpose.
designSystem.setTokens: The contrast gate reads the end state of the whole batch: change a palette step and the role that sits on it together.

The answer is the change: `changes` (the overrides added, changed or removed), `errors`, at most 20 `warnings` about what changed, and `warningCount` / `warningsByReason` for the whole system. A dry run says `dryRun: true`.
designSystem.lint: Read-only; run it through `dry_run_ops`. The answer also carries the whole compiled CSS: read `findings`.
designSystem.diff: Read-only; run it through `dry_run_ops`. The answer also carries the compiled CSS: read `diff` and `findings`.
designSystem.resetToBlueprint: Destructive: ask the user before running it, and say what scope it resets.
designSystem.deleteVariant: Pages may use the variant: check the outline of the pages (`variant=` in each line) and ask before deleting.
brand.setup: `acknowledgeContrast: true` saves a brand whose pairs fail AA. Set it only when the user explicitly says to save anyway.
media.upload: The file travels as base64 inside the tool call (images up to 5 MB). For a file on the user's computer, call `upload_media_file` of the plugin's `libretto-files` server with the path: it sends this operation without the bytes passing through the conversation. Write the base64 yourself only for a tiny file. The answer's `id` is the media id to place with `{ "$media": "<id>" }`.
media.list: Find an image by file name, then reference it in an image node as `{ "src": { "$media": "<id>" } }`.
media.recordUpload: Records bytes already staged by the admin's upload route, which an MCP token cannot reach. From MCP use `media.upload`.
font.recordUpload: Records a font file already staged by the admin's upload route, which an MCP token cannot reach: upload font files in the admin, or use `font.importGoogle`.
content.importMarkdown: Pictures must already be in the media library (`media:<id>` or the file name).
history.undo: Undo is refused with 409 when a later batch changed the same documents; undo the later one first, or rebuild the change by hand.
publication.publish: Publish only on the human's explicit go in the conversation. Alone in its batch, with `history` in `baseRevisions` (from a fresh `site_context`) and `"confirmed": ["publish"]`. The answer's `version.id` is the version to roll back to later.
publication.activate: Needs `versions.activate`: a platform admin, or the workspace owner of the site's workspace. Take the version id from `publication.versions`. It replaces the draft as well: unpublished changes are lost.
publication.rollbackPage: Restores one page of the draft from a version; publish afterwards (with the human's go) to serve it.
page.create: Needs `site.structure`: a platform admin, or the workspace owner on the sites of their workspace; another editor gets 403 and asks the owner. The admin follows the same rule.
motion.applyRecipe: Read the recipes and their knobs first (`motion.listRecipes` or the `motion` resource). After applying, the answer's `motion.*` findings name scene problems (hidden-at-rest, overlap...): fix them before finishing.
site.updateLanguages: Needs `site.admin`: only a platform admin's token. An editor or workspace owner asks a platform admin to add or remove a language.
tree.node: The read to use before any node edit: props, styles, meta, variant and theme of one node, its children to `depth`. Its `revision` is the `tree:<pageId>` base revision. `cut` names the children left out: read them with another `tree.node` if you need them.
catalog.read: The whole registry at once. Use `catalog.index` (or the `catalog` resource) to choose a type, then `catalog.entry` (`catalog/<type>`) for its props.
designSystem.read: Small by default: an index of sets, themes, component variant keys and token group sizes. Ask for one group's values with `tokens` (`design-system?tokens=space`); `css: true` only when you need the stylesheet.
designSystem.readComponent: Filter before reading: `variant` and `state` first, `own: true` for the cells actually set. Page with `cursor` while `nextCursor` is set; `total` says how many match.
publication.versions: The ids `publication.activate` and `publication.rollbackPage` need, with dates, notes and which version is live. Read it before any rollback.
publication.pending: What a publish would ship, by area, everyone's changes included. Read it before asking the human for the go; a changed page still in draft status stays out.

pending.note: Names the skills already use that the registry in data/ does not hold yet (Libretto branches not merged: feat/agent-tickets for ticket.*, feat/mcp-fonts-preview for font.upload). --check accepts them and lists them; remove an entry once --sync brings it in.
